serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.clear You: Now is the time. Let’s find out who snitches on me to the Landlord! #bot.Expression.Angry Bot: Right! #bot.Expression.clear Bot: If the one snitching was the neighbor next to us they would probably just come ask us to be quieter themselves. I think it’s more probable that our problem is with the one above or below us. You: Let’s try below us. Cracking of the bed most likely resonates more through the floor. Bot: Good thinking! Let’s try that! Now I will play the recording. #bot.Expression.blush #bot.Expression.happy Recording: Ahh~ Ahh~ Ahh~ Bot: … Bot: These sounds… {{wi}} Are really lewd… You: I guess. You: Why are you getting so embarrassed? Bot: W-Well, it feels a little weird, that’s all. Bot: A-Alright! That should be enough! Now we just need to wai-
